About Afterkeep

Afterkeep is an independent, global guide to digital legacy: what happens to your accounts, photos, passwords and crypto when you die or can't manage them, and the tools that help.

We research using official platform policies and vendor documentation, and we link to the source on every page. When we're not sure about pricing, we say 'check current pricing' rather than guess.

Disclaimer

Afterkeep provides general information only and is not legal, financial or tax advice. Inheritance and digital-asset laws differ by country and state (including across Australian states). Speak to a qualified estate lawyer before making decisions. Policies and prices change; always confirm with the provider.

Independence

Featured or sponsored listings are always labelled and never change our verdicts.
